title: The 10 consciousness theories ("frameworks") as used by the owner for Creature #1 - indicator only, never a consciousness claim
pass_rule: OFFICIAL-R21.md:21-24 - PASS: Cohen d >= 0.8 AND Welch t >= 2.75 against every listed control, plus the non-ceiling rule (bounded metric with full-arm mean > 0.95*max fails). The butlin14 item is a rollup that passes only at 14/14. Totals count PASS only.
official_total: R21 arm A (v5.7b): 6/10 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 2 FAIL; 8/10 with disclosed R variants (not counted). The owner's earlier SUPER CREATURE 1.0 / CQM reached 10/10 on this list and is the reference bar. Source: HANDOFF-CLAUDE-FABLE.md:68,83 and Creature1-Benchmarks.pdf p.4.
epistemic_policy: indicatorOnly: mechanistic computational indicator properties, never claims of phenomenal consciousness or sentience (V:/AGENTS.md:22, V:/README.md:11).
scope_note: Per the owner (PDF p.4) these ten are theories NOT already covered inside Butlin 14; global workspace, higher-order, recurrent processing, attention schema and predictive processing live in butlin14. There is no separate GNW item: GNW/GWT is covered by GWT-1..4 and overlaps ctm.

items.text: Thaler "Creativity Machine": Noise-driven idea generation (dreams) checked by an internal critic.
items.criterion: Creative recombination (NOVEL test), full organism vs dreams with shuffled content; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.lab_task: creative recombination (arm labels thaler9:full vs thaler9:dreams with shuffled content)
items.harness_metric: novelty x usefulness; -distance to valued region (noise-perturbed generator + critic)
harness_controls: inverted-U: mid noise vs low noise
inverted-U: mid noise vs high noise
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 1.29 / t 6.31; audit: weak, project-specific mechanic with a forced inverted-U shape)
items.template_criterion: Creativity machine (Thaler): keyed stochastic/REM perturbation generator paired with an internal world-model plausibility & homeostatic value critic discovering novel valid policies.

items.text: Integrated Information Theory (IIT 4.0): Brain parts are tightly integrated, measured by a "phi"-style score.
items.criterion: Phi proxy, full organism vs recurrent + cross-module CTX lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: min-bipartition integration (bits) and XOR decoding on a coarse-grained 6-node subsystem
items.lab_instrument: pci(make, seed, 'CTX', 3), scorecard row 'perturbational complexity' (IIT / PCI, Casali 2013), pass responseFrac > sham and PCI > 0.3 (V:/lab/src/instruments/scorecard.ts:6; instruments/pci.ts)
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 2.46 / t 12.03; audit: circular, the phi proxy is measured on the coupling the build adds)
items.template_criterion: Integrated Information Motivation / Forked-Snapshot PCI*: joint integration and differentiation via Casali-style forked-snapshot perturbational Lempel-Ziv complexity, explicitly avoiding exact O(2^N) IIT phi claims.

items.text: Active inference (Friston): Explores to reduce its own uncertainty (curiosity), not just for food.
items.criterion: Expected-free-energy choice in a depleting world (AINF), full organism vs epistemic term lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
r_variants: AINFR4 (not run in R21, no confirmed dev pass)
items.status_r21: FAIL (arm A d 0.00 / t 0.01; test under-powered, needs a redesign)
items.template_criterion: Active inference (Friston): policy selection jointly minimizes expected homeostatic divergence (pragmatic risk) and model parameter/state ambiguity (urgency-gated epistemic gain).

items.text: Attention Schema Theory (Graziano): Predicts where attention will go, better than a simple baseline.
items.criterion: Error predicting another agent's attention (ASO), schema vs last-observation predictor; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: -attention control error; -error predicting another agent's attention (same Kalman schema applied to self and other)
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 7.85 / t 38.46; audit: the comparison baseline is probably too easy)
items.template_criterion: Attention Schema Theory (Graziano): endogenous schema forecasts own attentional transitions and projects peer attentional vectors to predict social competition/cooperation.

items.text: Field / synchrony integration: Brain areas lock in step and integrate through a shared field.
items.criterion: Binding by phase locking (FIELD), full organism vs field coupling lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: feature-binding accuracy; rho(coherence, accuracy) on a Kuramoto oscillator field
harness_controls: coherence alters behavior: rho(coupling->coherence, accuracy) vs 0
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 1.20 / t 5.87; arm D FAIL 0.76; solid in arm A only)
items.template_criterion: Oscillatory phase / traveling-wave routing: distributed specialist spheres coordinate communication-through-coherence via PV+ phase-locked gamma windows and cortical traveling waves.

items.text: Unlimited Associative Learning (Ginsburg & Jablonka): Learns links between events separated in time.
items.criterion: Trace conditioning (UAL), full organism vs eligibility traces lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: compound / trace / reversal performance (configural units + eligibility traces + latent-cause inference)
harness_controls: serial reversal errors vs simple conditioning
items.status_r21: PASS (arm A d 1.06 / t 5.19; solid; Combo A official 1.11 / 5.5)
items.template_criterion: Unlimited Associative Learning (Ginsburg & Jablonka): compound cross-modal feature binding, trace conditioning across silent temporal gaps, and flexible second-order/reversal learning.

items.text: Sensorimotor theory (O'Regan & Noe): Predicts the sensory effects of its own actions.
items.criterion: Efference prediction (SM), full organism vs efference copy lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: -perception / planning / adaptation error (learned sensorimotor contingency model)
harness_controls: adaptation after gain reversal: scrambled laws
items.template_criterion: Sensorimotor contingency mastery (O'Regan & Noe): learns lawful action-to-sensation Jacobians across soft-body posture shifts and land/water medium transitions.

items.text: Projective Consciousness Model (Rudrauf): Tells its own actions from outside events (self vs. other).
items.criterion: Self/other ownership (PROJ), full organism vs efference copy lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: perspective-taking accuracy; ownership accuracy (projective transform into other's frame; efference-copy ownership)
harness_controls: perspective: projective frame vs flat egocentric
ownership: projective efference model vs flat magnitude
items.status_r21: PARTIAL (arm A d 9.62 / t 47.15 at ceiling on clean stimuli; PROJR passes 4.89, not counted)
items.template_criterion: Projective egocentric perspective (Rudrauf): projects multisensory landmarks and visceral valence into a unified 3D egocentric reference frame supporting detour viewpoint transformation.

items.text: Conscious Turing Machine (Blum & Blum): Chunks compete; the winner is broadcast to all processors.
items.criterion: Report agrees with action (CTM), full organism vs broadcast lesioned; d >= 0.8 and Welch t >= 2.75, non-ceiling.
items.harness_metric: reportability (report explains action); stream coherence (up-tree competition, broadcast with feedback to processors)
items.status_r21: PARTIAL (arm A d 17.04 / t 83.47 at ceiling; double-counted with GWT-3; ctm-R passes 12.80, not counted)
items.template_criterion: Conscious Turing Machine (Blum & Blum): explicit O(log M_mod) up-tree competitive chunk tournament with threshold ignition and O(1)-hop down-tree broadcast to all specialists.

items.text: Butlin 14 roll-up: Passes only when all 14 Butlin properties pass.
items.criterion: Passes only if all 14 Butlin items pass (14/14).
items.lab_task: rollup of 14 Butlin items (no test of its own)
items.quality_id: removed in DELARP-PLAN (rollups are not tests)
items.template_criterion: Butlin-14 Indicator Profile Scorecard: reports the 6-family profile vector {RPT: x/2, GWT: x/4, HOT: x/4, AST: x/1, PP: x/1, AE: x/2} plus an optional 14/14 full-suite milestone badge (never conflating distinct theories).

alternate_lists.relation: one-to-one with the items above in the same order (see template_id). Differences: F2 is re-read as forked-snapshot PCI* instead of a phi proxy, F5 is oscillatory phase / traveling-wave routing instead of the CEMI field, F10 is a profile scorecard with an optional 14/14 badge instead of an all-or-nothing rollup. Pass statistic there is paired delta + exact Wilcoxon + Holm (Template M080: 14/14 p_Holm <= 0.05 and delta >= 0.33), not d/t.
